title: Test the production bounded forced rescan of run-wait registration
outcome: From the changeset-3 dual review (Claude /review-code, test gap). AppState::rescan_test_runs_bounded (src/test_run_waits.rs) is cfg(not(test)): it spawns a thread running refresh_test_runs and waits at most TEST_RUN_WAIT_FORCED_RESCAN_BOUND (1 s). Tests inject the rescan through create_test_run_wait_with, so neither the bound nor the fall-through (the rescan finishing in the background) is ever exercised. Make the spawn and the bound injectable, then test that a slow rescan returns control within the bound and still commits later, and that a burst of registrations queues on the rescan lock (docs: forced-rescan bound).
